title: Concept: Composer lockfile downloads a distribution over cleartext
description: composer.lock declares a `dist.url` that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The archive crosses the network unencrypted, so it can be replaced before Composer verifies anything.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.lock (composer).
risk: The archive crosses the network unencrypted, so it can be replaced before Composer verifies anything.
